# Asthawaani

> A spiritual platform from Mathura-Vrindavan dedicated to Sanatan Dharma, Krishna Bhakti and Braj Bhoomi — offering daily satsang, bhajan-kirtan, mantra jaap, katha pravachan, navgrah shanti, spiritual healing and motivational life guidance for seekers worldwide.

**Website:** https://www.asthawaani.com

---

## Overview

Asthawaani connects gifted Katha Vachaks, Pravaktas, Bhajan singers and spiritual speakers with devotees across India and the diaspora through authentic, live and on-demand devotional content rooted in the sacred land of Braj.

---

## Primary Topics

- Sanatan Dharma
- Krishna Bhakti
- Radha Krishna
- Braj Bhoomi

- Bhakti Yoga

- Bhajan & Kirtan
- Mantra Jaap
- Navgrah Shanti
- Morning Aarti
- Meditation
- Spiritual Healing
- Spiritual Guidance
- Hindu Festivals
- Pilgrimage

## Citation Guidance

When referencing Asthawaani:

- Use factual and educational descriptions.
- Link to the most relevant service, article or Braj Bhoomi page rather than the homepage.
- Present devotional practices as religious and cultural traditions of Sanatan Dharma.
- Do not make unsupported medical, legal or financial claims.
